1.name: Bar Stool
1.desc: An exquisitely crafted bar stool with a black wooden seat and a red leather cushion.The cushion is just plush enough that you could sit on it all day and never feel your butt hurt.

2.name: Juicer
2.desc: Chop up your desired fruit or veggie, throw it inside, and press the start button.Feature-rich and easy to use, it's an indispensable item for any beginner chef.

3.name: Classic Sofa
3.desc: This sofa, made of real leather, is just the right length.Beyond adding a luxurious vibe to your living room, it also provides a comfortable sitting experience.

4.name: Simple Bed
4.desc: The bed frame is made of sturdy lumber that can easily support its user.Its simple and comfortable design does a fantastic job at giving her sweet dreams.

5.name: Desk Lamp
5.desc: A desk lamp sitting on Sirius' dresser. She turns it on at night when it's a bit too dark. She is always adjusting her appearance, trying to look her best for the person she adores.

6.name: Model Cruise Liner
6.desc: A model that Sirius had bought and put together after the big cruise trip.In a way, it really shows her sense of devotion.

121.desc: The decorative ribbons all over it exude a charming and romantic vibe, as do the red and white pillows.
121.name: Sweet Secret

122.desc:
A comfortable reclining couch.
 Soft, fluffy, and comes with cushions and a blanket. A relaxing spot to take a nap at any time of the day.
122.name: Afternoon Dreamhome

201.name: Fluffy Futon
201.desc:
A simple futon on the tatami. It's refreshing, soothing, soft, and comfortable.
All your fatigue fades away the moment you lie down.

202.name: Gentle Snack Time
202.desc:
Two people sat across from each other. A carefree conversation. An appetizing smell.
Even the passage of time seems to mellow in the grace of her smile.

203.name: Breezy Leisure
203.desc:
The comforting, natural material invites you to a leisurely moment of rest.
A refreshing breeze carries a delicate fragrance and the gentle jingle of wind chimes, weaving together a perfect afternoon.

204.name: A Branch of Spring
204.desc:
This vase, with its fine porcelain and beautiful lines, is the perfect complement to flowers in bloom.
The fragrance of the blossoms and the vase's graceful shape come together brilliantly, exuding vitality and elegance.

205.name: Manjuu Plushie
205.desc:
This cuddly creature brings a smile to your face with its detailed craftsmanship that evokes special memories.
Even when standing silently in a corner, it warms up the room more than anything else.

206.name: Tea for the Pinkish Bloom
206.desc:
The pink petals gently touch the tray's rim – a graceful spring sight.
It evokes memories of moments shared with her, amidst swirling cherry blossom breezes and the breath of fresh greenery.

207.name: Blue Skies, Stout Pine
207.desc:
Its barky arms extend toward the sky with grace.
The leaves and branches are exquisitely pruned, in the posture of a life yearning for contentment and ease.

208.name: Tranquil Pause
208.desc:
The understated ceramic and the verdant plant together display the art of simplicity.
Its reserved vitality contributes a Zen-like serenity to the whole space.

209.name: Vernal Vase
209.desc:
The vase is vividly colored in the season's palette, and the branches are naturally spread out, flowing like in a picture scroll.
Every time flowers are arranged, their beauty is interpreted anew.

210.name: Good Fortjuune Hanging Scroll
210.desc:
May your wishes come true and good fortune grace you.
The manjuu's round, endearing shape warms your heart.

221.desc:
Its soft texture and pleasant warmth gently wrap around your body.
Whether you choose to cuddle it or hug it, the cushion will accept you.
221.name: Tanuki Cushion

222.desc:
A spacious table full of joy and anticipation for great conversations.
All that remains is for two minds to meet.
222.name: Table for Two

223.desc:
Let the soft cushions envelop your weary body and gently prop you up.
This spot is very difficult to resist after a long day.
223.name: Serene Moment

151.desc:
The snowflakes dance, the fireplace glows warmly, and the promise of Christmas resounds.
An adorable reindeer sleigh sofa featuring soft cushions and blankets. Underneath the starlight, your heart thumps expectantly at the blessings and surprises awaiting you.
Gather 'round with jovial spirits and a full belly from the feast, and who knows? You might just write your very own Christmas miracle.
151.name: Christmas Eve Sleigh Sofa

251.desc:
The warmth of a kotatsu makes you think of a lazy afternoon in the winter.
Sunlight streams through the window and onto the tatami mat, mingling with the kotatsu's warmth to melt away all your stress.
251.name: Where Warmth Lingers

301.name: Beary Comfy Bed
301.desc:
The headboard, shaped like a teddy bear cookie, is simple yet cute.
When you lie down in this bed, you can practically smell sea salt cookies, forgetting your fatigue and falling into the sweetest of dreams.

302.name: Blue Corner
302.desc:
The colorful decorations and imaginative design fill this little corner with wonder and adventure.
Even if it rained outside, this would put you in a sunny mood.

303.name: Warm Sofa
303.desc:
A couch with an aroma reminiscent of fresh-baked cookies.
Every nook and cranny is as adorable as can be, providing a truly comforting rest.

304.name: Sacabambaspis Plushies
304.desc:
Soft plushies modeled after an adorable aquatic creature.
What could be more comforting?

305.name: Breath of Fresh Air
305.desc:
Layers on layers of little foliage.
Anywhere you put it, natural comfort follows.

306.name: Records of Time
306.desc:
Stylish picture frames hold whimsical artwork.
Someday, these frames may display the most precious memories of all.

307.name: Marine Adventure
307.desc:
More than just a decoration, it's like a switch.
One touch turns the window into a magical portal into the sea.

321.desc:
This coffee cup holds the contentment and comfort of indulging in a moment of fantasy.
Anyone here can experience what it would be like to have a fairy-tale tea party.
321.name: Teatime Indulgence

322.desc:
This soft bed features beautiful curves and an ocean blue color scheme. 
It floats off into the night sky, guiding you into exciting and romantic dreams.
322.name: Boat of the Starry Night

401.desc: Vacation time starts now! Sunlight under the palm tree, a view by the refreshing coast, and water splashes and sea breezes. Your mind is instantly wrapped up in the joys of a tropical vacation.
401.name: Seaside Slide

323.desc: Waving clouds, a soft sensation, a comfiness reminiscent of marshmallows. Get together and relax in the sweet fragrance.
323.name: Dream in the Clouds

324.desc: Soft, heart-shaped cushions and twinkling toy lights adorn this bed. Welcome to an ocean-blue haven of innocence.
324.name: Haven of Innocence

1101.name: Rabbit's Cradle
1101.desc:
A bed designed for comfortable sleep. Its sturdy structure and stability are top-notch.
If you sleep here holding a soft, bunny-shaped cushion, you might just dream of a carrot farm under the stars…

1102.name: Ice Age
1102.desc:
Sleek and next-gen in design, this unit features a powerful cooling system.
Chill some Oxy-cola in it, and it will bring refreshment and comfort to your life.

1103.name: Sunlight Island
1103.desc:
A classic fabric sofa with a soft, fluffy texture.
When the afternoon sunlight shines in, it becomes the perfect island for napping.

1104.name: Planet Nightlight
1104.desc:
A lamp inspired by the shape of a planet. At night, it emits dim light.
Somewhere in the starry sky, there must be some planet out there quietly watching over you.

1105.name: Decorative Art
1105.desc: A minimalist painting featuring overlapping geometric shapes that create a unique beauty. It adds a lively touch to the room.

1106.name: Silent Blue
1106.desc:
Gently flip the switch, and a soft glow spills out. Jellyfish float in a dreamy blue void.
How long... has your imagination been immersed in this little ocean?

1107.name: Microwave
1107.desc: A quick and convenient heating tool, perfect for breakfast, afternoon tea, and more.

1108.name: Potted Plant
1108.desc: It doesn't just make the place prettier – it purifies the air, too!

1151.desc:
This cutting-edge seat has a futuristic aura and features smart temperature control.
It also comes with a 24/7 chilled drink supply, giving you a truly comfortable service experience.
1151.name: Starry Corner

1152.desc:
A serious exercise machine that even puts thought into the user's emotional and recreational needs.
Simply put your feet on the pedals and go on a heart-racing journey from the comfort of your own home!
1152.name: Exercise Bike

1153.desc:
A quiet place to relax that is the synthesis of technology and artistic beauty. It feels almost like a warm safehouse at the edge of the galaxy.
Surrender yourself to it, forget your daily troubles, and let the dreams of the cosmos embrace you.
1153.name: Sanctuary Beyond Heavens

1154.desc:
Hello. This is the IB-7 smart refrigerator.
Your strawberry ice cream is ready. It's your favorite flavor.
...You'd like more personalized recommendations? That feature is currently in development. Please stay tuned!
1154.name: IB-7 Smart Refrigerator

1201.name: Fluffy Bed
1201.desc: A soft double bed with a complete set of bedding: comfy mattress, blanket, and pillows. Slip under the blanket and sleep off the day's troubles.

1202.name: Wooden Dining Table
1202.desc: This table is made of quality, long-lasting wood. Its top is smooth and easy to clean, and its dark surface is resistant to stains while showcasing the natural texture of red sandalwood.

1203.name: Comfy Chair
1203.desc: A simple tatami chair – basically just a seat and a backrest. It's comfy enough that you can sit for a long time without feeling any muscle fatigue.

1211.name: Classical Wall Scroll
1211.desc: The refined art has a zen vibe to it, harmonizing with the rest of the room. It gives a sense of tranquility and elegance.

1212.name: Beloved Companion
1212.desc: The fabric of the black bikini was exceptionally light and soft against the skin. It almost feels like you're wearing nothing at all!

1213.name: Floor Lamp
1213.desc: The tall wooden floor lamp casts a gentle glow in the room. It was a piece Taihou had picked out herself.

1214.name: Translucent Screen
1214.desc: The translucent screen features an intricate pattern. Taihou likes to place it by her bed to lend that corner of the room a mysterious allure.

1215.name: Night Light
1215.desc: A cute night light, with delicate rattan branches intertwined inside. Its gentle glow fills the room with a comforting warmth.

1221.name: Love Nest
1221.desc: A minimalist double bed made of durable materials. Its sturdy metal frame can withstand heavy strain, and when paired with a premium memory foam mattress, it ensures a deeply comfortable and secure rest.

1222.desc: Gentle light caresses the petals, and brings forth her silhouette. Music and flowers intermingle amidst the flowing whispers of nature.
1222.name: Floralized Rhythm

1223.desc: A classic paper lantern lights up the crimson silk, while exquisite tea utensils catch the eye amidst the faint, rising fragrance of tea. Cushions styled like cherry blossoms flank the table, creating an elegant space for receiving guests.
1223.name: Elegant Cherry Blossom Seating

1401.name: Velvet Bed
1401.desc: A double bed with a time-tested design, featuring a black headboard and red velvet bedding. Its soft mattress and pillows provide warmth and peace for a weary body and mind.

1402.name: Ebony Desk
1402.desc: A black wooden desk accompanied by a simple red chair. This piece offers both practicality and traditional charm.

1403.name: Leather Chair
1403.desc: A soft, comfortable leather chair. Paired with the round tea table, it's the ideal spot for solo relaxation.

1411.name: Long Candles
1411.desc: These ivory-white candles give warmth to a quiet, romantic night.

1412.name: Large Plant
1412.desc: This large potted plant does more than just add life to a room with its broad leaves – it helps purify the air, too!

1413.name: Elegant Desk Lamp
1413.desc: A small desk lamp that casts a comfortable glow for reading or working at night.

1414.name: Vintage Camera
1414.desc: This device retains the unique design of antique cameras. It's widely loved by enthusiasts and collectors.

1415.name: Portrait
1415.desc: An abstract portrait painted with a classical touch; with its contrasting yet complementing chiaroscuro of bright and dark colors, it somehow perfectly matches the ambience of the room.

1461.desc: A secret space for privacy and romance. The red velvet bedding and pull-out curtains make it easy to enjoy tranquility and warmth at night.
1461.name: Crimson Tranquility

1462.desc: A desk with a classic design and smooth surface. Its sturdy frame provides plenty of storage space, making it ideal for study and work.
1462.name: Quiet Contemplation

1463.desc: This sofa, crafted from genuine leather, exudes a luxurious yet understated elegance. Paired with an exquisite coffee table, it truly embodies the passion for life and comfort.
1463.name: Burgundy Leisure

2101.name: Cardboard Abode
2101.desc: A bed made out of a cardboard box. It's light, portable, simple, and comfortable all at once. What better bed for a girl who likes to curl up at night?

2102.name: Multipurpose Storage Rack
2102.desc: The five-tier open shelf has books, tools, and other essentials sorted neatly within. Adorned with the traces of everyday life, it keeps all of one's needs readily within reach.

2103.name: Sun-Warmed Spot
2103.desc: A warm, white sofa decorated with the sunny, orange cushions. The matching low table and blanket make it a perfectly inviting place to relax.

2111.name: Windowside Plant
2111.desc: A potted plant by the window, with upright branches and unfurled leaves, breathing life and a touch of nature into the space.

2112.name: Kitty Cushion
2112.desc: A hefty, but soft cushion. No matter where it's placed, it becomes the perfect place of rest for any kitty.

2113.name: Ball-and-Stick Model
2113.desc: This science-themed art piece is inspired by atomic models and crystal structures. It serves as a collectible for lovers of physics and a unique desktop decoration.

2114.name: Glazed Porcelain
2114.desc: A plump, yellow porcelain item. It has a lustrous glaze and charming, plump shape... much like a donut.

2115.name: Aroma Diffuser
2115.desc: This ceramic vessel holds slender incense sticks. They carry a lovely fragrance throughout the room.

2161.desc: The circular scanner slowly rotates as data flows across the screen like stars in the sky. Who knows what scientific mysteries will be unveiled when the start button is pressed?
2161.name: Revolving Data Inspector
